title: cineraria lyratipartita
intro: Cineraria lyratipartita, commonly known as the cape marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern region of South Africa. The plant is known for its vibrant orange and yellow flowers, which are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cineraria lyratipartita include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-anxiety and anti-inflammatory effects.
